trails.name: Briceljk summit
trails.why: Briceljk is a 2,346 m high mountain in the western Julian Alps and the highest peak in the ridge of the Bad Wall, which rises more than 1000 m above the Koritnice valley and extends from Vrh Krnice in the southwest to Plesivice in the northwest.
